qa_pairs.question: What is the proper tightening sequence for hitch to body installation?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Hitch bolts, 2. Axial strut bolts, 3. Reinforcement bracket collar nut

qa_pairs.question: What Loctite number should be used for the slotted nut for take-up pipe to hitch?
What is the difference in torque between M10 8.8 and M10 10.9 bolts for the trailer hitch?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the trailer hitch section?
qa_pairs.answer: The M40 slotted nut for take-up pipe to hitch at 220 Nm
